xmldoc.short_description: Read only the header of a WFDB record.

param_input_item.param_description: the record, with or without its .hea extension.

param_output_item.param_description: the same neutral struct wfdb.read returns, but with no samples and no annotations.

description.p: Only the text header (name.hea) is read, so the signals, their formats, gains and rates can be inspected without lifting a long signal file off the disk. It is the shorthand for wfdb.read(name, 'Data', false, 'Annotations', false).

example_item.example_item_data: r = wfdb.header('100'); printf('%d signals, %g Hz\n', numel(r.signals), r.rate);
